jobs.title: Environmental Scientist
jobs.description:
About Us

TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

TRC is actively seeking an Environmental Scientist for employment supporting our San Francisco, CA office. 

Responsibilities

Conduct biological field surveys which may include wetland/waterbody delineations, habitat, or wildlife and plant species-specific surveys.
Conduct data review and preparation of reports from field surveys.
Aid in preparation of technical reports and agency correspondence.
Aid in preparation and obtaining jurisdictional determinations.
Abide by Company policies and procedures.
Other duties and special projects as assigned.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications include a bachelor's degree in environmental science, natural resources, biology, ecology, or related field, and 1 to 4 years of post-degree experience.
The Field Biologist will work closely with other TRC biologists in TRC's Planning, Permitting, and Licensing practice.
We are looking for individuals enthusiastic about his/her work with a strong commitment to client service and technical excellence.
The positions will require regular travel away from home and some projects may require overtime and/or extended workdays and work weeks.
Strong ability to prioritize, organize, and perform multiple work assignments simultaneously.
Excellent written, verbal, and technical communication skills, along with the ability to maintain a positive attitude working under aggressive schedules and challenging work conditions such as heavily vegetated, rough terrain and hot/cold weather conditions.
The ability to aid in and/or prepare clear and concise reports, procedures, correspondence, and other written materials.

Benefits
* :
TRC offers a competitive benefit package consisting of:

Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance.
401k package that includes both traditional and Roth IRA options and Company match.
Paid time off contingent upon full time or part time status and level of seniority (ranging from 15 to 25 days per year).
All full-time employees enjoy a minimum of 8 Paid Holidays per year.
TRC ensures that all employees, including those that work part-time, receive paid sick, family, and disability leave in accordance with the laws of their state of residence.
These benefits are applicable to US employees depending on their employment status (full time, part time, or temporary). TRC offers jurisdiction specific benefit packages for International and Puerto Rico employees.

Compensation
: In accordance with local law, the below salary range is applicable for the job and location associated with this requisition. Compensation will vary based upon experience, education, skill level, geographical location, and other compensable factors.

Other Compensation:
Employee may be eligible for participation in the Company’s annual Discretionary Bonus Program which is contingent on Company, Business Segment, and Individual performance against Key Performance Indicators which vary by year and employee.

Disclaimers

TRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site.

TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time.

Salary Range

USD $26.75 - USD $40.15 /Hr.

jobs.title: Environmental Health Safety Specialist
jobs.description:
Date posted:
ASAP

Pay: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00 Per Year

Location:

1155 Coleman Avenue, San Jose, CA 95110

Job description:

About the Company:

Founded in 2006, we are a leading provider of global employment outsourcing solutions that empower businesses with top talents recruitment, cost optimization, ensure compliance, and streamline hiring processes abroad.
With global operations spanning the AP, EMA, LA and NA, ZONBERATION has served over 30 Fortune 500 companies and leading internet corporations across diverse industries, including automotive, e-commerce, tech products, consumer goods, gaming, real estate and finance.

Position Summary:

Our company maintains long-term, stable partnerships with many international corporations. Our work with leading technology companies continues to grow. We have successfully integrated top-tier professionals directly into their operational teams, enhancing their capabilities across multiple functions and contributing to shared success.
We are now recruiting a dedicated and detail-oriented Senior EHS Specialist to join our client’s dynamic tech environment. In this specialist role, you will be responsible for executing comprehensive EHS strategies, maintaining compliance, conducting risk assessments, and supporting the development of a strong safety mindset across all venues, including corporate offices, production facilities, and major events.

Job Description / Scope Of Work
Job Title:
Senior EHS Specialist
Location:
San Jose
Job Type:
Full-time
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior EHS Specialist to join our team. This role will be responsible for driving the implementation of EHS strategies, ensuring business operations comply with corporate policies and local regulations, fostering a strong safety culture, and enhancing employee health and safety awareness.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership:
Develop, implement, and continuously improve regional EHS strategies, policies, and procedures in alignment with corporate and business objectives.
Compliance & Risk Management:
Ensure full compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local EHS regulations. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate EHS risks across operations.
Incident Management:
Lead and oversee incident response, investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation to prevent recurrence.
Auditing & Inspection:
Plan and conduct regular EHS audits, inspections, and assessments. Track and drive closure of action items to ensure sustained compliance and safety performance.
Program Development & Training:
Design, deliver, and maintain effective EHS programs, training, and communication initiatives for employees at all levels.
Stakeholder Collaboration:
Work closely with cross-functional (XFN) teams—including Operations, HR, Facilities, and Legal—to integrate EHS into business processes and promote initiatives such as wellness, ergonomics, and employee assistance programs.
Reporting & Analysis:
Prepare and present detailed EHS performance reports, metrics, and insights to senior management and stakeholders.
Team Support & Development:
Mentor and support site-level EHS personnel and operational partners, fostering a culture of safety ownership and continuous improvement.
Business Travel:
Willingness to travel nationally and internationally as required to support regional and global business needs.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

Education:
Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Health & Safety, Occupational Health, or a related field. Advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CSP, CIH, NEBOSH) is a plus.
Experience:
Minimum of 3–5 years of progressive EHS experience.
Regulatory Knowledge:
Strong working knowledge of local, state, and federal EHS regulations. Familiarity with international standards and best practices is an advantage.
Communication:
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare high-quality reports and deliver effective training.
Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:
Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop actionable strategies to improve EHS performance.
Technical Proficiency:
Strong computer skills, including proficiency with MS Office and EHS management systems/software.
Flexibility:
Ability to adapt to changing business needs and work outside standard hours when necessary.
Travel:
Openness to regular national as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in multinational or matrix organizational environments.
Demonstrated success in leading cultural change and EHS program implementation.
Knowledge of sustainability practices and wellness program integration.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Job function

Administrative and Project Management

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting
